title: Android Libraries
seo: Kotlin library and Android SDK development
meta: Reusable Kotlin libraries and SDKs with tests and docs, ready for your own apps or your team. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Android libraries and SDKs you can reuse
overview: When several apps share the same code, we pull it into a Kotlin library that you add through Gradle. We keep the public interface small, write unit tests and instrumented tests, document it with examples and set up versioning so each release is traceable. You can host it in a private repository for your team or publish it yourself.

pkgs.blurb: One small, tested library with a README.
A larger library with docs, a sample app and version tags.
A full SDK with networking, error handling and publishing setup.

faq: You do. It is delivered to your repository, and you choose the licence or keep it private. We do not keep copies for other clients.
Can you extract a library from my current app?
Yes. We move shared code into its own module, tidy its interface and update the app to use it. Updating further apps to use the library is quoted separately.
Can it support Java projects too?
Yes. We keep the public interface friendly to Java callers where that matters, and test it from a small Java sample. Kotlin-only features are noted in the docs.
Wherever you prefer: a private Maven repository, GitHub Packages, JitPack or your own server. Premium sets up the publishing steps in your account and explains how to release a new version.
